name: Capitalism
overview: Scripture highlights the value of diligence and wise stewardship in managing resources, as seen in Proverbs where the diligent are rewarded and prudent investment is commended. Enjoying the fruits of one’s labor is presented as a good gift from God, affirming the blessing of honest work and provision. At the same time, the Bible calls for righteous judgment and defense of the poor, warning against exploiting the needy or undervaluing just compensation, emphasizing integrity and fairness in economic dealings.
